recent: Harvest Miracle 在 2026 年 9 月 29 日举行第 30 届年度股东大会，所有决议均获股东通过，包括 10% 股份配发与发行授权。公司于 8 月 27 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收与净利均较去年同期增长。近期亦多次公告提供财务援助。
notable: 股东在 2026 年 9 月 29 日的第 30 届年度股东大会上通过所有决议，包括 10% 股份配发与发行授权。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 27 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利按年增长 320.0% 至 298.6 万令吉。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 6420.5 万令吉，按年增长 14.3%，按季增长 13.4%；净利为 298.6 万令吉，按年增长 320.0%，按季增长 36.9%；净利率为 4.7%，高于上一季度的 3.9%。

recent_en: Harvest Miracle held its 30th AGM on 29 September 2026, where all resolutions including the 10% share allotment and issuance mandate were approved by shareholders. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August, with both revenue and net profit rising year-on-year. It also made several announcements on the provision of financial assistance recently.
notable_en: Shareholders approved all resolutions at the 30th AGM on 29 September 2026, including the 10% share allotment and issuance mandate.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August, with net profit up 320.0% year-on-year to RM2.986 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM64.205 million, up 14.3% year-on-year and 13.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM2.986 million, up 320.0% year-on-year and 36.9% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 4.7%, higher than 3.9% in the previous quarter.
